identity: ONE original heavily armoured sentinel, the Shard Guard veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the ivory-white full plate armour edged in gold, the closed visored helm with a radiant golden sun-ray crest, the dark blue tabard and long cape with gold star motifs, gold greaves and sabatons; no visible face. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE long dark-shafted glaive with a gold-wrapped grip and a curved blue crystal blade, carried low diagonally with the blade near the ground at screen right; the screen-RIGHT arm bears ONE tall rectangular gold-framed crystal pavise shield with a sun emblem at the top. Preserve the glaive, the pavise, the sun crest and the armoured adult proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full glaive blade, the pavise, the crest, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic, glow, beams, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the glaive or shield.

idle_h3_v1.action: A steady sentinel idle that loops. He breathes, the shoulders rise and fall under the plate, he resettles the pavise on his arm and lifts the glaive blade a little off the ground, the helmeted head turns slightly to scan, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted; the cape stirs gently. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: March in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with heavy armoured steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The glaive is carried low diagonally and the pavise held at the side; the cape and tabard swing with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE glaive thrust toward screen right. He raises the glaive and draws it back across his body as the knees bend, then lunges forward on the front leg and drives the crystal blade out level to full reach at screen right past the pavise, pulls it back and lowers it to the original low diagonal stance. One thrust only; the pavise stays on the screen-right arm.

hit_h3_v1.action: He starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The helmeted head and shoulders rock back, the pavise swings out and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the glaive and the shield, then he rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Swing the tall pavise forward in front of the body, bend the knees and crouch low behind it with the glaive braced beneath, then hold the covered guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying salute. He lifts the glaive and raises it upright high beside the pavise with the blade pointing to the sky, holds it there briefly, then lowers it back to the original low diagonal stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily from standing. His knees buckle and he sinks down behind the pavise, leaning on it, and stays there a moment. Then he topples onto his side and lies down, finishing lying motionless with the helmeted head at screen left and the boots at screen right, the pavise lying over him and the glaive on the ground in front. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
